protocol.definition: A-Dynamic = A-layer candidates only; dynamic features prev, prev2, previous bonus, Hot15; 500-draw history; alpha75; clip ±1.5. Top10 = raw score top10, no diversification.
protocol.important: A-layer membership of the future winner is not knowable pre-draw. A-layer-only summary is an oracle/conditional diagnostic. All-200 summary is what happens if A-Dynamic is blindly used every draw.
